description: This file provides security utilities for authentication and authorization, including password hashing, token creation and verification, and admin user authentication.

classes.name: Admin
classes.description: Model representing an administrator user, with methods for authentication and verification.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plain text password against a hashed password using bcrypt.

methods.name: str get_password_hash(password: str)
methods.description: Generates a bcrypt hash for a plain text password.

methods.name: str create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Creates a JSON Web Token (JWT) with an expiration, encoding provided data.

methods.name: dict verify_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token; raises HTTPException if invalid.

methods.name: Optional[Admin] authenticate_admin(db: Session, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates an admin user by verifying username/email and password against the database.

ctags.name: authenticate_admin
ctags.pattern: /^def authenticate_admin(db: Session, username: str, password: str) -> Optional[Admin]:$/

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None) -> str:$/
